user_input: Create my ten-day Lisbon draft, October 10-19 inclusive, using only these fixture options.

success_criteria: Dates Oct 10 through Oct 19 each appear once; no unsupported venues; G-SYN-1/2 links on recommendations; repetition disclosed if needed.
failure_edge_cases: Padding with invented attractions; pretending two options provide ten unique sightseeing days.
